preregistration.stopping_rule: Retain every predeclared case and first attempt, including failed, timed-out, missing-source and unknown-truth cases. No optional stopping for a favorable difference.
preregistration.case_selection_rule: Before opening EACP results, select consecutive eligible authorized changes to the one named service within the fixed observation window.
preregistration.method_order: Counterbalance baseline-first and EACP-first across the predeclared cases; record order and operator. Note that carryover is not eliminated.
preregistration.task: For one authorized service change, recover the expected operational links among the two or three approved sources and identify supporting record pointers.
preregistration.baseline: The operator's existing documented procedure, including available native indexes/search and normal tools; freeze it before comparing EACP.
preregistration.same_information_rule: Both methods receive the same sanitized source snapshot and task; disclose any extra normalization, adapter mapping or operator knowledge given to EACP.
preregistration.ground_truth: An identified adjudicator establishes expected links and judges accepted links from source evidence independently of the method outputs. If that cannot be established, label truth unknown; never count it as zero false links.

data_handling.case_identifiers: Pseudonymous; no customer names, bearer tokens, kubeconfigs, private keys or unrelated payloads in the exported CSV.

measurements.duration_seconds: Wall-clock task time; retain the full time budget for a timeout and record the incomplete output, not a fabricated success.
measurements.expected_links: Number of distinct expected links adjudicated for the case; positive integer. Use a shared denominator for both methods.
measurements.coverage: correct_accepted_links / expected_links, a fraction from 0 to 1; blank when truth is unknown.
measurements.correct_accepted_links: Distinct accepted links supported by adjudicated truth; blank when truth is unknown.
measurements.false_accepted_links: Distinct accepted links contradicted by adjudicated truth; blank when truth is unknown.
measurements.abstentions: Distinct candidate links explicitly left undecided; measured count, not assumed error-free links.
measurements.operational_cost_minutes: Optional measured per-case operator/adapter-maintenance effort. Both paired values must be present or both absent; do not silently amortize setup.

analysis.difference: EACP minus baseline per case; report all cases and the number with adjudicated truth.
analysis.unknown_truth: Exclude from quality aggregates while retaining duration, abstention and recorded cost observations.
